tasks.title: Create mission bootstrap structure
tasks.done_condition: All bootstrap files and scripts exist in the repository.
tasks.notes: Completed in the initial bootstrap iteration.

tasks.title: Add single-task execution script
tasks.done_condition: A script can read tasks, select one safe task, and record a start or skip event.
tasks.notes: Completed with scripts/execute-task, scripts/tasklib.py, and execution logging.

tasks.title: Add human-review gate helper
tasks.done_condition: The system can classify a task as human-review-required and stop before execution.
tasks.notes: Completed with review-gated task metadata and execute-task stop behavior.

tasks.title: Add bounded episode runner
tasks.done_condition: A bounded script can run repeated agent iterations, stop on completion, and stop on human-review-required tasks.
tasks.notes: Implemented by scripts/episode and aligned to the Ralph-style bounded loop.

tasks.title: Review any task that adds external network calls
tasks.blocker_reason: Resolved by human approval for public outbound network calls without secrets.
tasks.done_condition: A human explicitly approves the addition of external network calls and documents constraints.
tasks.notes: Resolved narrowly: outbound network calls are allowed for public/open use with no secrets exposure.
tasks.completion_summary: Human approved outbound network calls for public/open-source use, with no secrets exposure or private authenticated access.

tasks.title: Review authenticated or secret-bearing network integrations
tasks.blocker_reason: Anything involving secrets, auth, external writes, spending, deployment, or private systems still requires human approval.
tasks.done_condition: A human explicitly approves the higher-risk network scope and documents constraints.
tasks.notes: Replacement sentinel that preserves the constitution for higher-risk networked behavior.

tasks.title: Add task completion helper
tasks.done_condition: A script can mark an in-progress task done, append a completion log entry, and record what changed.
tasks.notes: Smallest next step so the system can close loops, not just open them.
tasks.completion_summary: Added scripts/complete-task, shared tasklib completion helper, and eval coverage for completion evidence.

tasks.title: Teach episode runner to close completed tasks
tasks.done_condition: The bounded episode loop can complete the current in-progress task with an explicit summary before committing the iteration.
tasks.notes: This keeps the loop consistent with the new completion helper instead of leaving task closure as a manual step.
tasks.completion_summary: Updated scripts/episode to require an explicit COMPLETION_SUMMARY, run complete-task after a passing eval, and commit only after the task is durably closed.

tasks.title: Track blocked tasks without stopping unrelated work
tasks.done_condition: The selector skips tasks marked blocked_by_human and a status view shows blockers separately from executable work.
tasks.notes: Needed so unattended loops can keep progressing on other safe tasks while blocked items wait for humans.
tasks.completion_summary: Added blocked_by_human support to task selection and a status view for current work, next work, and blockers.

tasks.title: Add explicit human blocker commands
tasks.done_condition: Humans can block and unblock tasks with explicit reason/resolution commands and the actions are logged.
tasks.notes: This creates the minimal human/AI handoff loop for paused work.
tasks.blocker_reason: Waiting for human decision on scope
tasks.completion_summary: Added scripts/block-task and scripts/unblock-task so humans can explicitly pause and resume tasks with durable notes.

tasks.title: Continue AFK runs past blocked tasks
tasks.done_condition: The episode runner records blocked tasks and keeps using remaining iterations on other safe work instead of stopping immediately.
tasks.notes: This aligns AFK behavior with the expectation that blocked task 3 does not prevent tasks 4 and 5 from running.
tasks.completion_summary: Added a real temp-repo integration check to `scripts/eval` that verifies `scripts/episode` records blocked tasks and continues using remaining iterations on later safe work instead of stopping immediately.

tasks.title: Add supervisor daemon for repeated AFK episodes
tasks.done_condition: A local daemon script can launch bounded AFK episodes repeatedly, sleep in clean idle-blocked state, and resume when executable work appears.
tasks.notes: This turns episodic AFK runs into a persistent local operating loop without adding secrets or private integrations.
tasks.completion_summary: Added a minimal `scripts/supervisor` daemon that relaunches bounded AFK episodes, sleeps in clean idle-blocked state, resumes when executable work appears, and extended eval plus shared task helpers and README coverage for the new supervisor loop.

tasks.title: Add planner-generated task reporting
tasks.done_condition: The system records when and why new tasks were generated so humans can review planning decisions after AFK runs.
tasks.notes: Makes the new planning step inspectable and easier to trust.
tasks.completion_summary: Added explicit planner rationale reporting by storing `planning_reason` on generated AUTO tasks, logging `planning_reasons` in `planned_next_tasks`, surfacing the rationale in `scripts/status` and README, and extending `scripts/eval` to require and integration-test that planning evidence.

tasks.title: Add idle-state status summary command
tasks.done_condition: A status summary can distinguish active work, planned work, blocked work, and clean idle-blocked state in one command.
tasks.notes: Helps humans quickly understand whether the system is waiting or working.
tasks.completion_summary: Updated `scripts/status` to report a single overall state plus explicit clean-idle-blocked and planned-work summaries, added eval coverage for active/planned/clean-idle-blocked status modes, and documented the richer status view in `README.md`.

tasks.title: Add supervisor daemon for repeated AFK episodes
tasks.done_condition: A local daemon script can launch bounded AFK episodes repeatedly, sleep in clean idle-blocked state, and resume when executable work appears.
tasks.notes: This turns episodic AFK runs into a persistent local operating loop without adding secrets or private integrations.
tasks.planning_reason: The loop can already plan and execute bounded episodes, but it still needs a persistent local operator that keeps relaunching those episodes while preserving review gates.
tasks.completion_summary: Prevented `scripts/plan-next` from recreating already-covered planner tasks by deduplicating against matching pending, in-progress, or done work, and added eval coverage that fails if completed planner templates are re-planned.

tasks.title: Add planner-generated task reporting
tasks.done_condition: The system records when and why new tasks were generated so humans can review planning decisions after AFK runs.
tasks.notes: Makes the new planning step inspectable and easier to trust.
tasks.planning_reason: The planner currently creates new work with only titles and done conditions, so humans need explicit rationale to audit why each new task entered the queue.
tasks.completion_summary: Added latest planner-event rationale reporting to `scripts/status`, factored execution-log reading into `scripts/tasklib.py`, updated README status docs, and extended `scripts/eval` with an integration check that verifies humans can review the most recent planner-generated task rationale after AFK runs.

tasks.title: Add idle-state status summary command
tasks.done_condition: A status summary can distinguish active work, planned work, blocked work, and clean idle-blocked state in one command.
tasks.notes: Helps humans quickly understand whether the system is waiting or working.
tasks.planning_reason: Once planning and supervision exist, humans need a single status view that explains whether the system is actively working, waiting on a blocker, or cleanly idle.
tasks.completion_summary: Fixed the status-state model so `clean_idle_blocked` only applies when blocked tasks are the only pending work, added eval coverage for the distinct `STATE blocked` case, and documented that blocked-vs-clean-idle-blocked behavior in `README.md`.

tasks.title: Add supervisor cycle outcome summaries
tasks.done_condition: The supervisor records a short structured outcome for each AFK cycle so humans can inspect whether each relaunch ended in progress, clean idle, or failure.
tasks.notes: Makes unattended relaunch behavior easier to audit after longer runs.
tasks.planning_reason: Now that a supervisor exists, humans need a durable summary of what each AFK cycle actually did instead of only the raw log stream.
tasks.completion_summary: added durable `supervisor_cycle_summary` logging and console summaries for each AFK supervisor cycle, documented the new behavior, fixed cycle-limit exit after a completed cycle, and extended `./scripts/eval` with integration coverage for clean-idle supervisor outcomes

tasks.title: Add planner backlog breadth limits
tasks.done_condition: The planner can rotate through multiple safe improvement themes without re-adding covered work or flooding the queue with one theme.
tasks.notes: Keeps self-generated backlog growth controlled and easier to review.
tasks.planning_reason: Once the planner can keep generating work, it needs a simple breadth control so the queue stays varied and inspectable instead of repetitive.
tasks.completion_summary: Added planner theme metadata and a one-open-task-per-theme breadth limit in `scripts/plan-next`, documented the backlog-rotation behavior in `README.md`, and extended `./scripts/eval` with integration coverage that verifies the planner rotates across distinct themes instead of flooding one theme.

tasks.title: Add stale-work status indicators
tasks.done_condition: Status output highlights stale in-progress or long-blocked tasks so humans can spot neglected work quickly.
tasks.notes: Improves human supervision once the backlog and history get larger.
tasks.planning_reason: After richer status reporting exists, the next safe improvement is to surface neglected work so humans can intervene earlier.
tasks.completion_summary: Added stale-work indicators to `scripts/status` for aging in-progress and long-blocked tasks, backed by shared timestamp helpers, README docs, and passing `./scripts/eval` coverage.

tasks.title: Add task dependency metadata for planned work
tasks.done_condition: Planned tasks can carry lightweight dependency hints so the selector and humans can see why some work should wait.
tasks.notes: Adds more structure to a growing self-generated backlog without introducing a heavy workflow engine.
tasks.planning_reason: As the planner generates more follow-up work, lightweight dependency hints keep the backlog understandable and reduce accidental out-of-order execution.
tasks.completion_summary: added lightweight planner task dependency metadata, made next-task/status skip and report unresolved dependencies, and extended eval coverage for dependency-aware selection

tasks.title: Add AFK log index command
tasks.done_condition: A command can list recent AFK log files with timestamps and outcomes so humans can inspect unattended runs quickly.
tasks.notes: Improves inspectability of longer unattended sessions.
tasks.planning_reason: Once unattended runs accumulate, humans need a fast index over AFK logs instead of opening individual files manually.
tasks.completion_summary: Added `scripts/afk-log-index` to list recent AFK logs with parsed timestamps, outcomes, and last-task context, documented it in `README.md`, and extended `./scripts/eval` with integration coverage for the new log index command.

tasks.title: Add planner candidate audit command
tasks.done_condition: A command can show which planner candidates are covered, eligible, or blocked so humans can understand why the planner chose or skipped work.
tasks.notes: Makes planner behavior more explainable without adding external dependencies.
tasks.planning_reason: As the planner catalog becomes broader, humans need a direct way to inspect why candidate tasks are eligible, skipped, or already covered.
tasks.completion_summary: added a shared `scripts/plannerlib.py`, built a new read-only `scripts/planner-candidates` audit command that explains covered/eligible/blocked planner candidates using the same logic as `scripts/plan-next`, documented it in `README.md`, and extended `./scripts/eval` with passing integration coverage for the new planner audit behavior
